rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, holding that FCRA’s express definition of “person” supplies the clear statement for §§1681n and 1681o while reserving remedy-scope anomalies for future cases. Alito is very likely to dissent on the ground that punitive-damages and other structural mismatches create ambiguity defeating an unequivocal waiver, with a modest chance of separate concurrences (especially from Gorsuch/Thomas/Barrett) addressing how to handle punitive damages against the sovereign.
